user.title: Set up SunsetHue
user.description: Add one forecast location. New installations default to today's forecast.

data_description.location_name: A label shown in Home Assistant for this forecast location.
data_description.api_key: Create an API key in the Sunsethue developer portal. It is stored only in this config entry.
data_description.latitude: Decimal degrees between -90 and 90 for the forecast location.
data_description.longitude: Decimal degrees between -180 and 180 for the forecast location.
data_description.time_zone: An IANA time zone, such as America/New_York, used to calculate local forecast dates.
data_description.forecast_start_offset: Which local day to forecast. Today is the default. Each selected event type for that day uses one API request per refresh. The API supports at most three days from today.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SunsetHue
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement SunsetHue API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SunsetHue
reconfigure.description: Change this forecast location. Your API key is retained.

data_description.location_name: A label shown in Home Assistant for this forecast location.
data_description.latitude: Decimal degrees between -90 and 90 for the forecast location.
data_description.longitude: Decimal degrees between -180 and 180 for the forecast location.
data_description.time_zone: An IANA time zone, such as America/New_York, used to calculate local forecast dates.

error.rate_limited: SunsetHue is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
error.quota_exceeded: The SunsetHue daily API quota has been exceeded. Try again after the quota resets or increase the API allowance in the SunsetHue developer portal.
error.invalid_coordinates: The coordinates are invalid or unsupported.
error.invalid_request: SunsetHue rejected the request. Check your API key, coordinates, and account status.
error.invalid_time_zone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.

abort.min_ha_version: SunsetHue requires Home Assistant {version} or later.

data_description.forecast_start_offset: The first local date to request. Today is the default for new installations.
data_description.forecast_days: The number of consecutive dates beginning with the first forecast day. SunsetHue supports today through the day after tomorrow. Each enabled event type uses one API request for each selected date per refresh.
data_description.include_sunrise: Include sunrise forecasts. At least one event type must remain enabled.
data_description.include_sunset: Include sunset forecasts. At least one event type must remain enabled.
data_description.update_interval: How often SunsetHue is queried. A six-hour interval follows the API cache guidance; shorter intervals can use more API credits.
data_description.create_detailed_entities: Create separate event-time, cloud-cover, direction, and blue/golden-hour entities in addition to quality and quality-text sensors.

error.forecast_window_exceeds_horizon: The forecast window must stay within three days from today. Reduce the first day or the number of consecutive days.
error.invalid_forecast_days: Choose between one and three forecast days.

reauth_required.message: SunsetHue authentication failed. Reconfigure the integration with a new API key.
